newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds held onto early gains on Tuesday to close near all-time record highs hit earlier in the session, traders said.

Spain's market was supported by a positive trend in both U.S. T-bonds and the dollar, but dealers in Madrid said the main focus remained on EMU convergence. "The market is being aggressive, maybe a bit too much. It need news and more reasons to give value to this rise" a dealer at Fimat said.
The 10-year bond future rose to a high of 111.28, but pulled back into the close to 111.05, while on the cash market the yield was 7.15 percent with the spread testing the 135 bps.
